firstAttemptPreserved.meaning: Initial aborted module had no Playwright execution context; the first report failed a QA event-count assertion, not the recovered generation result. Root approved the single bounded correction; only one follow-up browser run was executed.

comparison.transportRequestId: Default clients called once per stage. Internal retry request.id equality is covered by the separate pure contract; this browser test does not intercept postMessage.

separatePureContract.scope: Persistent startup failure stops after2, cancellation during retry delay, and computation errors are verified in separate fake-clock contracts, not represented as browser observations.

observationLimits: The first aborted script does not expose a page.worker execution context. Its JavaScript object termination is not directly observable here; the pure contract covers that lifecycle.
Request.id retry equality is covered by the separate pure contract. This browser test does not wrap postMessage; original request value graph and actual result identity are exact.
Generation output comparison excludes only outer generationMs telemetry. No other result field is ignored.
